create_dataloader: create a Dataloader instance to load ambiguous candidate identification data from a JSON file
get_random_batch: get a random batch of dialog data with tokenized inputs and ambiguous candidate labels
get_entire_batch: iterate over the entire dataset in batches for evaluation or epoch training
create_visual_feature_loader: create a VisualFeatureLoader to load precomputed image features for ambiguous candidate identification
visual_feature_loader_cuda: move VisualFeatureLoader features to CUDA for GPU-accelerated training
